# NearBox

> NearBox is a live 3D multiplayer village on NEAR where the economy is the gameplay.
> Players sign in with Google, own capped NEP-245 items, trade them in an on-chain
> marketplace, equip them in the world, and take errands from nine NPCs who walk the
> same map. There are no wallet popups, seed phrases, gas prompts, or separate "web3
> mode": the chain is infrastructure, not a feature.

Public entry point: https://nearbox.lol

## Key facts

- Track 09 — Games With Real Economies.
- Five merchant NPCs (Alba, Bruno, Tomas, Vera, Rosa) each have a real NEAR account,
  a server-held key, inventory, and a personality expressed only through pricing weights.
- Pricing is deterministic and explainable: `price = clamp(base * stockFactor * demandFactor * personalityFactor, floor, ceiling)`.
  Every quote returns human-readable reasons shown in a tooltip.
- Materials and cosmetics are NEP-245 multi tokens in one deployed contract
  (`nft.runworld-nep245.testnet`), with capped supply per catalog.
- Marketplace escrow is deployed at `market.runworld-nep245.testnet`.
- Google login provisions a NEAR account derived from an MPC public key, created by a
  relayer. No extension, no seed phrase, no wallet UI.
- A deterministic fast-forward simulates one week of trade in about a minute using the
  same code the live loop runs.
- 8 minigames, Rapier physics, vehicles, cosmetics, procedural audio, mobile controls,
  and realtime multiplayer over WebSocket.

## Preferred citation

NearBox — a live 3D multiplayer village on NEAR where merchant NPCs with wallets price
real NEP-245 items and players move the market.
